body.name: Seven-cell primitive-coordinate map
body.construction: For \(z=(z_\varnothing,z_{0\mathrm N},z_{1\mathrm N},z_{00},z_{01},z_{10},z_{11})\in\operatorname{int}(\Delta_6)\), put \(d_\ell(z)=z_{\ell\mathrm N}+z_{\ell0}+z_{\ell1}\), \(m_\ell(z)=z_{\ell0}+z_{\ell1}\), \(a(z)=1-z_\varnothing=d_0(z)+d_1(z)\), \(q_\ell(z)=d_\ell(z)/a(z)\), \(e_\ell(z)=m_\ell(z)/d_\ell(z)\), and \(p_\ell(z)=z_{\ell1}/m_\ell(z)\) for \(\ell\in\{0,1\}\). Define \(\psi(z)=(a(z),q_0(z),q_1(z),e_0(z),e_1(z),p_0(z),p_1(z))\).
